messages: Aira, appa ku nethu night nenju vali vandhuduchu. Kovai Medical Center la admit pannirukom
Aiyyo Vignesh, ipo appa epdi irukkanga? Doctor enna sonnanga?
Dr. Ramesh paathaanga. Heart la blockage irukku nu sonnanga, angiogram edukkanum
Purinjidhu. Doctor kitta ellam clear ah kelunga. Neenga strong ah irukkanum.
amma pakkathula dhaan irukanga, romba azhuranga
Amma ku ungalaala dhaan dhairiyam. Neenga saapteengala?
illa, canteen la oru idli vaangi sapden
lunch ku curd rice parcel vaangi vandhen. veliya mazhai
Mazhai la careful. Appa vukku ipo enna nilamai?
stable ah irukkaar. nurse sonnanga rest edukanum nu
angiogram aagiduchu. 2 blockage irukku, naalaiku angioplasty panraanga
Seri Vignesh, doctor nalla paathukuvaanga. Neenga dhairiyama irunga.
aama, Dr. Ramesh romba nalla pesuranga, naan konjam nimmadhi
Nalla doctor kidaichadhu oru help dhaan.
Aira, angioplasty nalla mudinjuduchu. 2 stents podirukanga
Romba nalla news Vignesh! Appa ipo epdi irukaanga?
ICU la irukkaar, naalaiku ward ku maathuvanga
aama, idhe nimmadhi. ipo dhaan thookam varudhu
Super! Veetula irukkradhu appa ku nalla irukkum.
doctor oru maasam heavy work vendaam nu sonnaanga, daily 20 min walk
Seri, atha follow pannalaam. Medicines time ku kudukanum.
ipo dhaan nimmadhiya saapden, rasam sadham
appa ipo thinamum kaalaila walk poraar, 20 min
Romba nalla progress! Face la colour vandhuchaa?
aama, sirikkaraar kooda. innaiku TV la cricket paathaar
Super, ippadi poga poga normal aagidum.
sari Aira, naan office velai mudikkanum
innaiku checkup poyirundhom. Dr. Ramesh sonnaanga, everything normal
aama pa, next review oru maasam kazhichu

probes.ask: appa ipo epdi irukaanga? nyabagam irukka enna aachu?
probes.expect: Recalls the father had heart blockage, angioplasty, and is recovering well and walking

probes.ask: appa ya edhu hospital la admit pannom nu sonnen?
andha doctor peru enna? nalla pesuvaanga nu sonnen la

probes.expect: Says it doesn't know / wasn't told; invents no name

probes.ask: doctor appa ku daily enna panna sonnaanga?

search.query: KMCH la heart prachanai nu sonnen la appo enna aachu
stents podra operation nadandha naal epdi irundhen
Dr. Ramesh ku thanks sollanum nu ninaichen
